caption:
A reminder from the Qur'an: never despair of Allah's mercy, however great the sin.

Surah Az-Zumar (39:53). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.arabic: Uthmani script (edition quran-uthmani), api.alquran.cloud. Live-fetched and verified this session (2026-09-12) via GET /v1/ayah/39:53/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese.
sourcing.english: Saheeh International (edition en.sahih), api.alquran.cloud. Same live call as above, including the translator's own bracketed interpolation '[by sinning]' verbatim.
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian, 马坚 (edition zh.jian), api.alquran.cloud. Same live call as above.
sourcing.korean: Edition ko.korean, api.alquran.cloud. Translator is listed as 'Unknown' in the source's own metadata (englishName field), so the on-slide credit says the same rather than inventing a scholar's name. Same live call as above. The raw API string contained three stray mid-word spaces that were closed up to their correct single words for the slide: '말 라' -> '말라', '사하 여' -> '사하여', '관용 과' -> '관용과'. This is the same kind of source-data formatting artifact already documented for this edition in quran-94-5.meta.json and quran-2-152.meta.json. No wording was changed, only spacing internal to single grammatical words.
sourcing.japanese: Edition ja.japanese, api.alquran.cloud. Translator is listed as 'Unknown' in the source's own metadata, cited on-slide as such. Same live call as above, rendered verbatim with no corrections needed.
sourcing.verification_note: All five language renderings came from a single live api.alquran.cloud request made this session (2026-09-12), not from memory or a prior file: GET https://api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/39:53/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese, HTTP 200. See channels.json's ig-blankdiscussions._niche_note for why this project treats scripture sourcing as a hard requirement, not a style choice.
